summary: Global Net Lease, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement (Supplement No. 1, dated November 6, 2026) that merely amends its at-the-market common stock program. The filing adds Lucid Capital Markets, LLC as an additional sales agent and forward purchaser under the existing ATM Equity Offering Sales Agreement originally dated November 7, 2025, which covers up to $300 million aggregate gross sales price of common stock. No shares are priced, no premium or consideration is stated, and no board recommendation or advisor opinion appears. This is a routine shelf takedown update; no special-situation or risk-arb angle exists.
